scenes.beat: Nia pulls her discarded note back as a gloved hand reaches for it.
scenes.captionExclusion: Keep note and reaching hand unobstructed.

scenes.beat: Nia notices handwritten sheets collected on the janitor cart.
Nia blocks the cart and confronts Arun.
scenes.captionExclusion: Keep both faces and cart center clear.

scenes.beat: Arun gestures toward the art room; match cut to the paper box.
scenes.captionExclusion: Keep hand gesture and box latch clear.

scenes.beat: The writing stays face-down while Arun trims the inked strip and folds the blank paper.
scenes.captionExclusion: No caption over the hand-fold interaction.

scenes.beat: The crane joins dozens in a donation box; Nia realizes what he is doing.
scenes.captionExclusion: Keep donation card and reaction visible.

scenes.beat: Nia tears off the blank half of her note and they begin folding together.
scenes.captionExclusion: Keep both hands and final crease unobstructed.

captions.text: He never even turned the words toward himself.
